verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs describe it as a self-hosted gateway you run as one process on your own machine. Install paths include an installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, building from source, and optional Docker, plus a multi-tenant cell hosting mode. Community users independently report running it on their own hardware, including a NixOS QEMU VM with local models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the open-source license terms; the evidence shows only an 'Open-Source' tagline and a GitHub repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosted gateway that connects Discord, Google Chat, iMessage, Matrix, Microsoft Teams, Signal, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, Zalo, and more to AI coding agents.
Run one Gateway process on your own machine and message your AI assistant from anywhere.
Install OpenClaw - desktop app downloads, installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, from source, Docker, and more
Docker is **optional**. Use it for an isolated, throwaway Gateway environment or a host without local installs.
A user runs OpenClaw in a NixOS QEMU VM with local models in a config-based sandbox
